title: MySQL 8.4 — Storage IO
description: Answers whether storage is limiting the workload: engine-visible file IOPS, throughput, per-operation latency and redo-log pressure. Values come from performance_schema file summaries, not Azure platform estimates.

query.query: MysqlTelemetry | where RunId != 'verify-probe' | summarize LastSeen=max(Timestamp) by RunId | order by LastSeen desc | project RunId
MysqlTelemetry | where RunId == '$run_id' and TargetId != 'verify-probe' | summarize by TargetId | order by TargetId asc

panels.title: Read IOPS
panels.description: Physical file read operations per second, summed across instrumented MySQL file classes.

targets.query:
MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'operations_total', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)
| where TargetId in ($target_id) and tostring(Tags.mode) == 'read'
| summarize IOPS=sum(Rate) by Timestamp, TargetId
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Write IOPS
panels.description: Physical file write operations per second, summed across instrumented MySQL file classes.

targets.query:
MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'operations_total', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)
| where TargetId in ($target_id) and tostring(Tags.mode) == 'write'
| summarize IOPS=sum(Rate) by Timestamp, TargetId
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: File throughput
panels.description: Bytes per second read and written by instrumented MySQL file classes.

targets.query:
MetricSeriesRate('mysql.file_io', 'bytes_total', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)
| where TargetId in ($target_id) and tostring(Tags.mode) in ('read', 'write')
| summarize BytesPerSecond=sum(Rate) by Timestamp, TargetId, Mode=tostring(Tags.mode)
| extend Series=strcat(TargetId, ' / ', Mode)
| project Timestamp, Series, BytesPerSecond
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: File latency per operation
panels.description: Cumulative file wait delta divided by operation delta. This is engine-observed latency and is the primary storage-tier diagnostic.

panels.title: Redo log waits
panels.description: Innodb_log_waits per second. Any sustained non-zero rate means transactions are waiting for redo capacity or flush progress.

targets.query:
MetricSeriesRate('mysql.global_status', 'Innodb_log_waits', '$run_id', $__timeFrom, $__timeTo)
| where TargetId in ($target_id)
| project Timestamp, TargetId, WaitsPerSecond=Rate
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: File classes by workload and latency
panels.description: Ranks bounded performance_schema file event classes. High IOPS with low latency is healthy throughput; low IOPS with high latency points to storage or flush contention.
